title: ROO Secure IT Solutions — Refund Policy
summary: General refund-policy template for products and services.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: This is a general refund-policy template. The final policy must reflect the product type, customer jurisdiction, payment provider, contract terms and mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: 2. Digital Products and Services
sections.body: Eligibility for refunds may depend on whether a digital product has been accessed, delivered or materially used and on applicable consumer law.

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions
sections.body: Subscription cancellation and refund rules should be stated at purchase, including renewal timing and any statutory cancellation rights.

sections.heading: 4. Consulting and Professional Services
sections.body: Deposits, scheduled work, completed milestones and custom services may be subject to separate contractual terms.

sections.heading: 5. Requests
sections.body: Refund requests may be submitted to info@roosecure.com with the order identifier and relevant details. Identity or purchase verification may be required.

sections.heading: 6. Mandatory Rights
sections.body: Nothing in this policy is intended to remove or restrict non-waivable consumer rights.
